full_page.content:
1932, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 72 Cont.
Nov. Mrs. - 6. ..... work
Mary Ellen Irving
Mrs. Ethel - 42 - 5 children & husband - fractured skull
Victor DeCluer of Mt. Clemens - 52 - whole right side cold
Lucia Osbrook - 15 - of Lowel, Mass .- ten days - asks in tears for prayers that he return ... . 8 yrs away from confession.
Agnes Alexander - 37 - lost both breasts 7 mos. ago - 2 mos. obstruc- tion of intestine, now very weak can not raise her head.
Page 73
Blank Page
Page 74
Nov. Mrs. Witte has gwo grand-children 5 & 9 - children in irrelitious surroundings ....
Mrs. M. McMillem .... 4 children not baptized - bad accident - her- self disfigured
Mrs. Kaul & son ... Nervous brk.d. Mrs. Couletta - 40 - Heart - dropsey
Nov. 16 Mrs. F. Ramber - 35 - Los Angeles in hospital wants to recover health to care for her girls 11 & 14
Fred Pilett - 66 - cancer of gums Martha Girardo - 65 - has had two operations - each time a breast taken off. Now fears a return of malady.
Herman Hoffen - 7 - hurt at birth. Could not hold head up. Now since been here.
Mrs. Mary Banstahl - 43 - threatened with cancer of breast, fears operation.
Nov. 22 ! Purgatory. . . So Logical! Richard Manion (5565 Audibon Ave. ) Aug. 7 Aug. 31 - had received First Communion last June, a very bright child ... learned the Ten Commandments in one day - loved his mother dearly - Loved Holy Communion, joined Holy Name Society November 13 .... Came home on 14th very sick - Catechism next to heart under his clothes ...
